headline: US Mortgage Rates Fall for First Time in Months as Demand Drops
summary: The average long-term US mortgage rate fell to 7.32% in the first pullback in two months, while home purchase mortgage applications dropped 7% as high costs persisted.
why: Mortgage rates directly influence housing affordability, residential real estate transaction volumes, and mortgage lending activity across the United States banking sector.

impacts.name: Real Estate
impacts.why: Sustained high borrowing costs continue to weigh on homebuyer demand and transaction volumes despite a slight rate dip.
